text: Risk management is the process of identifying, assessing, and controlling threats to a project. The first step is identifying risks, which means finding out what could go wrong and how likely it is to happen. Once risks are clear, you need mitigation strategies, which are actions to reduce their impact or probability. It is also wise to have contingency plans in place, so you know exactly what to do if a problem occurs despite your efforts. Finally, monitoring is essential because risks change over time. By regularly reviewing the situation, you can spot new dangers early and adjust your plans. Good risk management helps projects stay on track and prevents small problems from becoming serious ones.
